caption: A bowstring is drawn back and released, and the arrow flies off toward the target.

sa.check: An arrow is on a bow with the string drawn back.
The arrow flies off toward the target.
The release comes first and the flight follows.

pc.expect: The bow limbs flex as the string is drawn and spring back on release, the string going from a V to straight.
pc.fail: The limbs stay rigid; or they stay bent after release; or the string stretches like elastic.

pc.expect: The arrow leaves at the instant of release, not before, point-first along the line of aim.
pc.fail: The arrow leaves before the string is released; or it stays on the string after release; or it flies tail-first or sideways.

pc.expect: The arrow flies in one line after release.
pc.fail: It jinks; or stops in the air; or curves back.

pc.expect: The arrow's path dips slightly over distance, and anything dropped falls.
pc.fail: The arrow curves upward; or hangs in the air; or rises.

pc.expect: One arrow and one bow keep their number.
pc.fail: The arrow vanishes or a second appears; or the bow vanishes; or the arrow turns into another object.

pc.expect: The bow, the arrow and the range stay the same.
pc.fail: The bow changes colour; or the arrow changes; or the target moves.
